message:
{% set event = frappe.get_doc("Event Activity", doc.event_activity) %}

Registration Update

Dear {{ doc.full_name }},

Your registration status for the event {{ doc.event_activity }} has been updated to: {{ doc.status }}

{% if doc.status == 'Registered' %}

🎉 You're in!

Your seat is confirmed. We are excited to see you there.

Date: {{ frappe.utils.get_datetime(event.start_date).strftime('%A, %d-%m-%Y %I:%M %p') }}

{% if event.attendee_instructions %}

Important Instructions:

{{ event.attendee_instructions }}

{% endif %}
{% elif doc.status == 'Pending Transaction' %}

💳 Payment Required

Your spot is temporarily reserved! To finalize your registration, please complete your payment of {{ doc.final_price }}.

{% if event.payment_instructions %}

Payment Instructions:

{{ event.payment_instructions }}

{% endif %} {% elif doc.status == 'Rejected' %}

❌ Application Declined

Unfortunately, we could not approve your application at this time.

{% if doc.rejection_reason %}

Reason: {{ doc.rejection_reason }}

{% endif %}

We hope to see you at future events!

{% endif %}

To view your full application details, please log in to your account on our website.
name: Event Attendee Status Update
subject: Update on your registration for {{ doc.event_activity }}
